patch_description:
Insert additional single-qubit RY rotations between the Z-diagonal multi-qubit motif layer (ZZZ)
and the doubly-controlled RZ layer (CCRZ). The added RY gates reuse the existing symmetry-grouped
parameter keys (ry_corner, ry_edge, ry_center), so no extra trainable parameters are introduced.
This breaks up long sequences of commuting Z-diagonal gates, increasing circuit expressivity and
mixing while keeping parameter efficiency. The change is purely a gate-ordering / interleaving
modification that is inexpensive (no new params) and aims to improve optimization and generalization.
